subject: SSO assertion snapshots, SCIM change log, and delivery timeline
messages:
From: Alex Porter <alex.porter@medizon.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: security@medizon.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 3 Sep 2025 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SSO assertion samples + SCIM change log (SOC2/SIG intake)

Jasmine —

Thanks for taking this. Medizon is doing a SIG intake tied to our SOC 2 readiness; the auditor asked for concrete artifacts around provisioning and SSO behavior. Can you provide the following for our security review?

- SAML assertion samples (sanitized) for successful logins and for a failed assertion scenario (last 90 days)
- SCIM provisioning delta export covering role assignments/changes for the last 90 days (format: csv preferred)
- A compact role->permission mapping (we only need the top 50 roles used in our tenant)
- Short notes on retention windows and redaction approach (do logs contain PII?)

Please let us know an expected delivery window and if you need an NDA or DocuSign before sharing. We prefer a temporary, time-limited link for downloads.

Appreciate a quick timeline.

— Alex
Alex Porter
Security Program Lead, Medizon Health
alex.porter@medizon.com
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: Alex Porter <alex.porter@medizon.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 3 Sep 2025 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SSO assertion samples + SCIM change log (SOC2/SIG intake)

Alex —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide an initial bundle of sanitized artifacts and a delivery timeline. Proposed plan: 

1) Within 48 business hours: 3 sanitized SAML assertion examples (successful login, MFA challenge, failed audience mismatch) + a README describing which fields were redacted.
2) By EOD 2025-09-10: Complete SCIM delta export (90 days) in CSV, and a compressed role->permission spreadsheet (compact view).
3) If you need raw logs beyond the SCIM deltas, we can arrange a one-time secure transfer under a short DPA addendum.

Notes on PII: assertion samples do include subject identifiers (email) by default; our standard practice is to hash or redact the subject value and any IP addresses. For the SCIM delta CSV we will remove user_full_name and email columns unless you request otherwise and sign the transfer.

Attachments we plan to include in the initial bundle: redwood-saml-samples.zip (three .txt assertion samples), scim-deltas-90d.csv (sanitized), role-mapping-compact.xlsx. Let me know if you need a different filename convention.

If you prefer a DocuSign first, send the contact and I’ll route to Legal. Otherwise I can upload to a time-limited GDrive link.

— Jasmine Liu
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 3 Sep 2025 14:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SSO assertion samples + SCIM change log (SOC2/SIG intake)

Jasmine — quick clarification from the provisioning side: when we export SCIM deltas the format includes a change_type column (add/update/remove), timestamp (UTC), actor_id (internal service account or user), and object_path (e.g., /Users/{id}/roles). For Medizon I suggest we: 

- Include a small mapping file that explains actor_id types (service_account_x -> provisioning system)
- Provide an example of the delta patch payload (JSON encoded) for one role assignment to show the shape auditors expect

I’ve got a short spec (scim-diff-spec.md) that explains the columns — I recommend attaching that. Also recommend keeping the CSV to top-level columns only (no nested JSON in cells) and a separate zipped payloads folder if they want full patch examples.

I’ll also flag any service accounts that are excluded from provisioning snapshots (we exclude ephemeral system service accounts) and add that list to the README.

— Karthik
Director, Product Ops — Redwood Inference
From: Alex Porter <alex.porter@medizon.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: security@medizon.com
Date: Thu, 4 Sep 2025 08:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SSO assertion samples + SCIM change log (SOC2/SIG intake)

Jasmine, Karthik —

That sounds good. A few quick additions: 
- We will need the assertion samples to indicate which exact SAML attributes are present (e.g., eduPersonPrincipalName, email, groups) — providing an annotated sample in the README helps.
- Please confirm whether IP addresses are present and that you will redact if required.
- We can accept hashed email identifiers in the scim CSV as long as you provide the hashing algorithm in the README.

No DocuSign required for the initial sanitized bundle — GDrive link is fine. Please provide a link that expires after 7 days.

Thanks — looking for the 48hr sample bundle.

— Alex
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: Alex Porter <alex.porter@medizon.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 5 Sep 2025 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SSO assertion samples + SCIM change log (SOC2/SIG intake)

Alex —

We uploaded the initial sanitized bundle to a temporary folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cExampleSecureLink (expires 2025-09-12). Included files: 

- redwood-saml-samples.zip (3 files: success-assertion.txt, mfa-assertion.txt, failed-audience.txt)
- scim-deltas-90d.csv (top-level columns; user identifiers hashed with SHA256; hashing details in README)
- role-mapping-compact.xlsx (top 50 roles with a short permission summary)
- README_redaction_and_format.md (explains redaction, hashing, actor_id mapping, and scim-diff-spec reference)

Quick pointers: IP addresses are redacted in all assertion samples. We used SHA256 with a per-tenant salt (non-reversible) for the user identifier column. The README contains the salt rotation policy and retention windows (SCIM deltas kept 90 days, SAML assertion logs 30 days by default).

If you want the full (non-redacted) logs for auditors under an approved DPA addendum and a signed NDA, we can arrange an SFTP transfer and a one-time cryptographic key for the package. Let me know the preferred POC for that route.

— Jasmine
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
